summary: v32.0.0-alpha.40 backend validation — Path A (disk-first rounds + native slide assembly). Ran the existing unit suite (test_alpha40_disk_rounds_and_slides.py, 12/12 green) and authored a new LIVE integration suite (test_alpha40_live_disk_rounds.py, 13/13 green) that hits https://standalone-tools.preview.emergentagent.com and physically inspects /root/Documents/BIG Hat Entertainment/Files/Trivia/<TYPE>/ before and after every CRUD op. All alpha.40 requirements verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: roundmaker.py and trivia_viewer.py are getting long — future work should consider splitting the disk-IO helpers (_write_round_bighat, _delete_round_bighat, _read_all_disk_rounds, migrate_rounds_disk_and_db) into a dedicated bighat_fs module to keep route files under 700 lines and reusable across roundmaker + trivia_viewer + presentations.

The disk-write path uses a slug + optional -<shortid> collision suffix; consider adding an idempotency check (e.g. read-modify-write with a hash) so migrations don't produce duplicate physical files if run twice with slightly different case/spacing.
trivia_viewer._lookup_round should log (not just swallow) missing-file lookups so ops can detect stale manifests instead of silently seeing placeholder covers.
seed_data_creation: All live tests create TEST_-prefixed rounds and clean up via DELETE. A brief manifest with TEST_ prefix is left in Files/Trivia/Rounds/ from the regression + placeholder cases; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alpha.40 disk-first Round Maker + native slide assembly is fully green on both hermetic unit tests and live-URL integration. New live suite at /app/backend/tests/test_alpha40_live_disk_rounds.py can be reused as regression. It inspects the physical .bighat filesystem under /root/Documents/BIG Hat Entertainment/Files/Trivia/<TYPE>/ — so the docs root must exist wherever this runs. Auth was not required (endpoints are unauthed in native mode as noted by main agent).
verified_features: POST /api/roundmaker/rounds writes .bighat with schema=bighat-round/v1, matching id/name and questions.
POST /api/roundmaker/rounds/{id}/duplicate writes a second file with (Copy) suffix in name.
DELETE /api/roundmaker/rounds/{id} removes both DB row and .bighat file.
GET /api/roundmaker/rounds merges DB + orphan disk rounds (verified by dropping a hand-crafted .bighat and observing it in the list).
Two rounds with identical names get two unique disk files (collision-suffix works).
GET /api/trivia-viewer/{id}/slides returns source='native-disk' with correct ordering: host, location, per-round (cover + N question + review + answers), and terminating final_scores.
Slide assembler emits placeholder cover slide (subtitle '(round data not found...')) instead of 500 when manifest references missing .bighat.
Alpha.38/39 regression: POST /api/presentations/import-trivia still writes manifest and GET /api/trivia-viewer/list surfaces it.
